race.comment: FLARESSENCE (9) looks the best of the raced brigade after missing by a lip at Eagle Farm last month. Kept fresh with five weeks between runs and with any natural improvement she should be right there again. MALAMAGIC (2) is a Spirit Of Boom colt on debut for the Gollan camp. Full brother to LR winner Malaboom, has impressed in both trials, and keeps Thompson. Can make a bright start. His stablemate WILCO (5) is another Spirit Of Boom colt on debut and has also trialled well. Low draw gives him a good sight. BODMIN MOOR (1) returns after a promising debut prep. Two trials have him ready to make his presence felt.
